enScope: Stays at Dispatch Center Lv. 4–5; requires [Swift] and [Precision] unbanned.

tabs.cnIdea: 前夫哥的破解版，迅捷成了就是无限真银斩，前夫哥再给精准转，以前夫哥和初雪为核心，3精准，初雪也吃迅捷和灵巧再配合ffo，也可以技能不带停，而且还有奥术附加伤害。两人合力就是集聚怪，对空，冰冻，反影为一体的究极怪物
tabs.enIdea: Core carries are [SilverAsh the Reignfrost] and [Pramanix the Prerita]. Once [Swift] is online, SilverAsh can chain infinite Truesilver Slashes; give him a [Precision] Isomorph (Damazti Isomorph + Precision Scope) for +30% DEF/RES ignore. Pramanix the Prerita benefits from [Swift] + [Agile] + Warfarin's SP trait to keep her skill active permanently while proccing [Arcane] bonus Arts damage—combining AoE grouping, anti-air, Freeze, and anti-Invisibility.

enTitle: The Witch King Arrives! 8-Leithanien Burst Carry
author: MLT不是麻辣烫
enScope: Can stay at Dispatch Center Lv. 4 for a long time to triple core 4-cost Casters.

<Damazti Isomorph>: When equipped together with specific Equipment, the equipped Operator is treated as a member of the corresponding Alliance

Destroyed when equipped; randomly obtain 1 Operator sharing the equipped Operator's primary Alliance

tabs.cnIdea:
本阵容可长时间停留在四本

前期靠云迹+复奏叠层奇迹
因为所需的医疗都在四五本
前期尽可能多拿能T能奶的保活

尽量控制在五回合升三本，在第八回合之前升四本
对子多留一些，在四本去碰奶羊和薇薇安娜，没碰出的话，在第十一回合前上到五本去找

同构体和小鼓优先给到空弦和雅雅，确保能开出6莱塔
有充裕同构体的话，可给小羊（不是奶羊）转职灵巧，与华法琳配合站位可额外叠层灵巧

站位推荐如下：
中期：空弦 → 黑键  华法琳 → 霍尔海雅
后期：空弦 → 奶羊  华法琳 → 小羊（没转职的依旧朝向雅雅）

最终成型：
8莱塔尼亚，3精准，3奥术，2聚合，2灵巧，2远见，2奇迹
tabs.enIdea:
Early game: Stack [Marvel] with Contrail + Ripresa, and pick up Defenders/Medics to preserve Life Points since core Medics are at Tier IV–V.
Leveling pace: Upgrade to Lv. 3 on Round 5, and Lv. 4 before Round 8. Hold pairs to triple into Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska and Viviana at Lv. 4 (or push Lv. 5 before Round 11).
Equipment & Isomorphs: Give Damazti Isomorph + Leithanian Snare Drum to Archetto and Ho'olheyak first to reach 6–8 [Leithanien]. Extra Isomorphs can give Eyjafjalla [Agile] to stack with Warfarin.
Positioning: Mid-game Archetto -> Ebenholz, Warfarin -> Ho'olheyak. Late-game Archetto -> Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska, Warfarin -> Eyjafjalla.
Final synergies: 8 [Leithanien], 3 [Precision], 3 [Arcane], 2 [Convergence], 2 [Agile], 2 [Foresight], 2 [Marvel].

cnTitle: 森蚺大丑精灵全程无漏一兜三，BOSS输出占比最高，大丑超强生存完全不死
enTitle: Immortal 4-Slot "Rowdy Tin" Solo Carry (Lv.2 Reroll)
author: 海伯利安之殇
cnScope: 不ban精准或灵巧，最好不ban灵巧，远见不ban更好还能刷经济。可以凑坚守加生存，到最后精灵基本都是一两百层，电狗和云迹能一直用到最后，还能对策频次怪。要是能开奥术也不错，三奥术防隐匿，不过大丑很能抗所以也不太怕。
enScope: Playable whenever [Agile] or [Precision] is unbanned (ideally [Agile] unbanned; [Foresight] is a great economy bonus).

strategies.enEffect: Passive: On Round 1, obtain 1 special Operator <"Rowdy Tin"> capable of equipping 4 pieces of Equipment

items.enEffect: Destroyed when equipped; randomly obtain 1 Operator sharing the equipped Operator's primary Alliance
Whenever dealing damage, recovers HP equal to 5% of the damage dealt; if held together with "Siphoner's Heart", combines into "Siphoner's Scythe"
Equipped Operator gains an additional Alliance determined by the other piece of Equipment they carry
When attacking targets 3 or more tiles away, damage dealt +30%
DEF +20%

tabs.cnIdea: 精准和灵巧至少其中一个无ban再玩，最好不ban灵巧。第二回合直接升本，前九回合都可以待在二本找电话（简易通讯机），给大丑直接用无限复制大丑。最低要求三个大丑合成精锐后再升本，可以考虑多留一个大丑（也就是一共四只，后面要是找到博士投影就可以给第二个也精锐）。二本期间找电狗（承曦）和云迹叠精灵，可以找渡桥（放后台凑远见+弱化版空弦），三合一碰空弦（青枳也可以）。初步成型能爽叠灵巧就直接升四本找吸血刀（汲取者镰刀），升五本找转（变形者），一个转可以配盾牌，精准望远镜等等来让大丑爽吃三四个盟约。找一个协助干员凑协助盟约。这样大丑自带吸血还能爽吃一堆盟约buff，并且攻速快所以开技能也快，伤害高吸血高基本死不掉（打隐秘铳骑超高减伤都能吸得起来血）。无论道中还是BOSS都是超强战力，一玩一个不吱声，而且操作无脑简单，快拿去上分吧！
tabs.enIdea: Upgrade to Dispatch Center Lv. 2 on Round 2, then stay at Lv. 2 for up to 9 rounds hunting for Simple Communicators to duplicate "Rowdy Tin" (since it has no Alliance, Simple Communicator copies it directly!) until it promotes to Elite—keep a 4th copy if you find Doctor Hologram later. While at Lv. 2, pick up Greyy the Lightningbearer + Contrail to stack [Agile]/[Precision], Mitm on Bench for [Foresight], and triple into Archetto or Poncirus. Once [Agile] stacks are rolling, level to Lv. 4 for Siphoner's Beak (lifesteal) and Lv. 5 for Damazti Isomorph + Precision Scope / Durable Shield so "Rowdy Tin" inherits 3–4 Alliance buffs across its 4 Equipment slots.

Destroyed when equipped; randomly obtain 1 Operator sharing the equipped Operator's primary Alliance
Destroyed when equipped; if you already own at least 2 copies of this non-Elite Operator, obtain 1 more copy of them; otherwise, randomly obtain 1 Operator of the same Tier
Destroyed at the start of the next round after equipping, promoting the equipped Operator to an Elite Operator
For 15 seconds after deployment, damage dealt increases to 135%, then gradually decays
When attacking targets 3 or more tiles away, damage dealt +30%

Redeployment Time -30%, Max HP -30%
Max HP +60%, recovers 8% Max HP per second; ATK +50%, and dealing damage deals an additional 30% of ATK as True damage

tabs.cnIdea:
激活6【卡西米尔】
大丑装备转职球和：
【卡西米尔战旗】、【突袭手雷】、【佣兵铭牌】
tabs.enIdea: Final setup: Activate 6 [Kazimierz]. Equip "Rowdy Tin" with Damazti Isomorph + Kazimierz Knightclub Pennant, Raid Grenade, and Mercenary Dog Tag.

tabs.cnIdea:
停留在商店Ⅱ本找电话，复制大丑，禁用初雪也可上本找；
其他盟约激活如下：
①.电狗+云迹【灵巧】
②.云迹+复奏【奇迹】
（复奏可不上场）

tabs.enIdea: Rounds 1–7 (Early Game): Stay at Dispatch Center Lv. 2 looking for Simple Communicators to copy "Rowdy Tin". Activate early synergies: Greyy the Lightningbearer + Contrail ([Agile]), Contrail + Ripresa ([Marvel]), Archetto + Greyy ([Precision]), Varkáris + Gravel ([Resilient]), and Blemishine + Ethan ([Raid]).

tabs.cnIdea:
给大丑装备转职球
其他盟约激活如下：
①.大丑+瑕光+玛恩纳+砾+远牙+耀光
【6卡西米尔】

tabs.enIdea: Rounds 8–13 (Mid–Late Game): Equip Damazti Isomorph on "Rowdy Tin" to reach 6 [Kazimierz] alongside Blemishine, Młynar, Gravel, Fartooth, and Nearl the Radiant Knight. Run Archetto + Ho'olheyak + Fartooth for 3 [Precision], Surtr/Entelechia + Gravel for [Resilient], and Blemishine + Surtr + Nearl for [Raid].

cnTitle: 无需六本干员！ 伊比利亚大c是蓝毒！
enTitle: No Tier VI Needed! Blue Poison 3-Precision Iberia Carry
author: Hanserrr

Unlocks when active [Iberia] Operator count reaches 4

Passive: The first time an Operator is promoted to an Elite Operator each round, gain 1 additional Promotion Reward

tabs.cnIdea:
前期尽量抓战力过渡
三本后抓旅骨空弦海沫 没有海沫的话温蒂是下位替代
三精准蓝毒解决了伊比利亚对单的痛点
boss战蓝毒是绝对核心 自用n15隐秘蓝毒50%输出
什么时候意识到蓝毒才是核心什么时候玩懂伊比利亚
tabs.enIdea: Pick strong tempo units early. After reaching Dispatch Center Lv. 3, roll for Homebound, Archetto, and Highmore (Weedy can sub if Highmore is missing). Activating 3 [Precision] on Elite Blue Poison (Skill 2) completely solves [Iberia]'s single-target Boss damage bottleneck without needing any Tier VI Operators.

3升2

出了霍尔海雅升4
出了冻河升5
tabs.enIdea: Leveling curve: Upgrade to Lv. 2 on Round 3, Lv. 3 on Round 4–5, push Lv. 4 after finding Ho'olheyak, and push Lv. 5 after finding Тоска. Combines 6 [Ursus] damage-to-HP-loss conversion and blocking Arts DoT with [Arcane] and [Swift].

author: ONN

tabs.enIdea: Assemble 3 [Leithanien] with Czerny early to stabilize mid-game rounds and farm Leithanian Snare Drums, then push Dispatch Center Lv. 5 to complete 6 [Leithanien] with Viviana, Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska, Logos, and Degenbrecher.

cnTitle: 我们阿戈尔终于起来了😭（如果捡不到聚合应该怎么办）
enTitle: Fortress Ægir: Aid + Durable Unkillable Wall
author: 公羽世家
cnScope: 有阿戈尔，坚守，助力等tag，其他羁绊能凑就凑，都是实打实的战力提升，重要的是随机应变
enScope: Ideal when [Convergence] / Skadi the Corrupting Heart is unavailable; stacks massive HP and DEF.

strategies.enEffect: Passive: When an [Ægir] Operator is defeated, adds stacks to the active [Ægir] Alliance equal to that Operator's Tier
Passive: When there are 3, 4, or 5+ active Alliances on the field, all Operators gain +20%/+30%/+40% ATK and Max HP respectively

Unlocks when Dispatch Center reaches Lv. 4
Tap to use (Cost 1): Obtain 1 [Ægir] Operator (Tier cannot exceed current Dispatch Center Level)
Replaces <With 6 different [Ægir] Operators on field> with: The first 3 [Ægir] Operators defeated for the first time summon the rightmost [Ægir] Operator from the Bench that can be deployed on their tile

items.enEffect: RES +20; attacks Silence the target's special abilities for 5 seconds
ATK +15%
DEF +20%
Equipped Operator deals +30% additional damage to enemies suffering from an Elemental Damage burst
For every active Alliance, grants +6% ATK and +6% Max HP to the equipped Operator (stacks up to 8 times)
Within 10 seconds after each deployment, attacks Stun the target for 2 seconds

tabs.cnIdea: 这把没有红蒂，运气不好，不过助力阿戈尔意外的很强，坚守叠生命，助力防御力，简直是城墙级别，道中兜底，结局要克莱门莎打爆条（需要加爆条伤害的装备）
tabs.enIdea: When [Convergence] isn't available, pair 6 [Ægir] with [Durable] (massive Max HP scaling + damage sharing) and [Aid] (high DEF scaling + end-of-round stacks to all active Alliances) using Roberta, Underflow, and Andreana. Mid-game is virtually impenetrable; in the final Boss fight, Clementia equipped with Bottled Volatile Reaction shreds Elemental burst bars.

tabs.enIdea: Hold pairs while banking 5+ Funds for Cannot's interest to level up quickly. Roll at Dispatch Center Lv. 4 for Gnosis (whose When-obtained refresh guarantees more Kjerag units) and triple into Lv. 5 Pramanix the Prerita and SilverAsh the Reignfrost.

cnTitle: 精灵奥萨为什么是最轮椅的阵容
enTitle: Why Agile-Arcane-Precision Sargon Is the Ultimate All-Rounder
author: 予世不及
cnScope: 盟约不完全刚需精准奥术灵巧，只禁用以上三个的其中之一时无伤大雅，空弦华法琳被办会有点难受但也不是完全玩不了，萨是核心不能与以上其中一个同时被禁。策略看自己喜欢即可，有搜牌和经济能力最好，战力如果对自己运营有自信或者不相信队友的话也可以选
enScope: Requires [Sargon] unbanned; works fine even if one of [Precision], [Arcane], or [Agile] is banned.

strategies.enEffect: Drag to use (Cost 0): Select an Operator in the Dispatch Center and transform them into a random Operator of the same Tier (up to 2 times per round)
Passive: When there are 3, 4, or 5+ active Alliances on the field, all Operators gain +20%/+30%/+40% ATK and Max HP respectively

Passive: Obtain 1 special Equipment <Damazti Isomorph> every 5 rounds
<Damazti Isomorph>: When equipped together with specific Equipment, the equipped Operator is treated as a member of the corresponding Alliance

Unlocks on Round 4
Drag to use (Cost 0): Select an allied Operator and immediately transform them into a random Operator 1 Tier higher (up to Tier VI)
Tap to use (Cost 0): Randomly gain 1–6 Funds (Cooldown in rounds equals the amount of Funds gained)

items.enEffect: SP recovery rate +0.15/s
Equipped Operator gains an additional Alliance determined by the other piece of Equipment they carry
Destroyed when equipped; randomly obtain 1 Operator sharing the equipped Operator's primary Alliance
When attacking targets 3 or more tiles away, damage dealt +30%
Destroyed when equipped; offers up to 3 Operators sharing the equipped Operator's primary Alliance in the Dispatch Center, and pick 1 for free (Tier cannot exceed current Dispatch Center Level)
Destroyed when equipped; sets maximum Deployment Limit to 9

tabs.cnIdea:
运营核心是前期小幅度叠精准奥术灵巧，优先找云迹拼灵巧过渡前期，格雷伊和霜叶灰喉前期优质过渡可以抓，记得留一下莎草。六到七回合左右升四本，或者在三本碰对子优先找空弦华法琳霍尔海雅，获得初步的启动资格。九到十回合升五本，找到鸿雪佩佩即游戏结束。六本看情况自己选择上，去找缪缪拿转是最重要的，真言可有可无。
最终成型阵容为三精准三奥术两灵巧两聚合，三到六萨
有萨转可以找优质精准和奥术终端，推荐蕾缪安逻各斯塔露拉，如果转的数量比较多可以给雅雅萨转和真言精准转开出六萨，最终阵营即可成型
tabs.enIdea: Final composition: 3–6 [Sargon] + 3 [Precision] + 3 [Arcane] + 2 [Agile] + 2 [Convergence]. With Damazti Isomorph + Sargonian Teaspresso, you can convert Ho'olheyak into [Sargon] and Mantra/Logos into [Precision] to hit 6 [Sargon] Quicksand tiles while Pozëmka and Ho'olheyak melt everything.

tabs.cnIdea: 前期找低费过渡，漏怪交给队友
tabs.enIdea: Rounds 1–3 (Early Game): Pick low-cost transition units like Specter, Frostleaf, Varkáris, GreyThroat, Contrail, Greyy the Lightningbearer, Click, and Miss.Christine to open [Arcane], [Precision], and [Agile] early. Hold onto Papyrus.

tabs.cnIdea: 中期找空弦等开三精准，其他盟约可同时开启过渡
tabs.enIdea: Rounds 4–7 (Mid Game): Before pushing Lv. 4, pick up Archetto, Vigil, and Homebound to activate 3 [Precision].

tabs.cnIdea: 这一时期找雅雅和华法琳，三个人开始启动精准奥术
tabs.enIdea: Rounds 8–10 (Scaling Phase): Roll at Lv. 4 for Ho'olheyak, Warfarin, Passenger, and Nightingale. Position Warfarin behind Ho'olheyak and Archetto behind your main stacker to turbo-charge [Precision] and [Arcane] stacks.

tabs.cnIdea: 找到鸿雪佩佩即可彻底成型，觉得灵巧不够的话可以再低压波或队友成型时换其他灵巧叠层手，我个人更喜欢用m3，打boss时记得把叠层手下掉换成终端
tabs.enIdea: Rounds 11–13 (Endgame Transition): Push Lv. 5 for Pozëmka, Pepe, and Mon3tr (who boosts surrounding stacking caps by +30%/+60%). Swap out pure stackers for high-rarity carries like Logos before the Boss round.

tabs.cnIdea:
前期
精准远见过度，给二星渡桥转精准。渡桥空弦互相转。
迅捷波登可，陨星，青枳都是很好的过度卡，转给迅捷霞光更是一技能不倒就可以不死。如果真的很高可以试着中期1技能w，终端3技能六卡锏。

启动终端
不屈摆渡人，和转不屈的霞光是启动用的套件，在霞光转到不屈前不用特意叠。
突袭核心在于给史尔特尔一个卡西米尔转职终端，中间可以借海默拿经济和过度。

如果以上都没有，就想办法转出精二叔叔，拿满装备，副盟约抓一个魔王保护一下叔叔输出。隐匿服也是针对高输出boss的好装备。


补充重点（因为可以抓的干员表只有20个，这些是一些补充）
经济的话，远见已经给出答案，剩下的就是奇迹，奇迹的星极可以作为无脑抓二合一的对象，小鱼则比较适配叔叔的嘲讽，同时和吉星，波登可的过渡，吃一下保底刷新免费的经济收益。突袭的伊桑也是优质的经济卡。
tabs.enIdea: Early game: Transition with [Precision] + [Foresight] (give Mitm a Precision Isomorph and pair with Archetto) and [Swift] (Podenco, Meteorite, Poncirus). Blemishine with [Swift] or [Resilient] Isomorph can tank indefinitely.`nCore transition: Use Varkáris + Gravel/Blemishine to stack [Resilient] and Hoederer + Blemishine to stack [Raid]. In the late game, give Surtr a [Kazimierz] Isomorph (Damazti Isomorph + Kazimierz Knightclub Pennant) and give Elite Młynar (Skill 3) a Precision Scope, backed by Nearl the Radiant Knight and Civilight Eterna.

cnTitle: 重铸大炎荣光，望别义不容辞

Replaces <With 6 different [Yan] Operators on field> with: When battle begins, gathers a portion of all [Yan] Operators' stats to summon 'Yan's Protection'

tabs.cnIdea: 前期有炎的低费棋子可以拿一张，没必要精英，一本不强求找拜松，拜松单卡强度不高，后面可以通过望的技能敲出来，优先保血量，差不多三到四本才有强度；渡桥空弦给炎转，空弦贴黍姐放，渡桥贴任意一炎放，前期尽量叠远见，用不到的棋子让望变，如果可以摸到人口加一就最后boss关下掉空弦渡桥开9炎
tabs.enIdea: Do not force Bison at Lv. 1; prioritize preserving HP until Dispatch Center Lv. 3–4. Give Mitm and Archetto [Yan] Isomorphs (Damazti Isomorph + Yanese Dagger) and position Archetto behind Shu to rapidly stack [Yan] and [Foresight]. Use Wang's drag command to transform unused Operators into [Yan] Operators; if you find an HR File (+1 Deployment Limit), reach 9 [Yan] on the Boss round to summon two 1.5x ATK / 90% DR Yan's Protections.

cnTitle: 谢拉格的逛街大山太深邃了，还是得小盟约，唯有小盟约

tabs.cnIdea:
谢拉格要绑着灵巧玩了，所以核心是云迹（而且云迹同时可以叠奇迹，找干员更省钱）
前期主凑小盟约不强追3谢，示例的云迹+晨曦格雷伊+雪猎+灰喉直接2灵巧3精准
之后找3谢，核心是耶拉和初雪，耶拉主要拿来产冰不刚需上场，初雪用来叠层，要等到干员攻速高起来且带冰才有用所以不优先
碰见投资人顺手拿了，开3投资方便产冰
后期要的效果就是大部分干员带冰吃高额灵巧，冻怪打输出
tabs.enIdea: Build around Contrail + Greyy the Lightningbearer + Snow Hunter + GreyThroat to activate 2 [Agile] and 3 [Precision] early while Contrail stacks [Marvel] for free refreshes. Add 3 [Kjerag] with Kjera (who generates Kjeragi Nevermeltice) and Pramanix (who stacks [Kjerag] every time an enemy is Frozen). With high [Agile] ASPD and Nevermeltice on ranged carries, enemies stay permanently Frozen.

cnTitle: 前期兜底后期斩首boss，超级轮椅的二本大丑灵巧维玩法
enTitle: Lv.2 Reroll "Rowdy Tin" into 6-Victoria & Agile Boss Assassin
author: xiaoguzi
cnScope:
在有维多利亚、灵巧云迹未ban的局可以考虑玩该阵容。
前期猛兜，若有飞行多上对空，若有频次上格雷伊。中期可能需要队友帮兜，但是前期一般会留下较高血量来提供高容错。后期需要考虑好站位，让大丑能够打到boss，基本上能做到一个大丑就有50播报。

——碎碎念——
   这套玩法借鉴了不少b站大佬的视频，为了方便各位博士能够快速上手这个轮椅玩法，结合自己的游玩体验写了这篇攻略，不过我自己的理解肯定有限，如果博士有其他理解欢迎指出🙏
   维丑玩法给我的感觉和灵巧阿戈尔很像，不过灵巧阿戈尔是中后期发力，维丑则是前后期发力。二者对博士的战场摆放能力都有较高的要求，道中需要让大丑尽可能覆盖多路，boss战需要考虑boss的行进路线。
   看到这里还不去卫一把试试吗🤓
enScope: Best when [Victoria] and [Agile] (Contrail) are unbanned.

strategies.enEffect: Passive: On Round 1, obtain 1 special Operator <"Rowdy Tin"> capable of equipping 4 pieces of Equipment

items.enEffect: Destroyed when equipped; randomly obtain 1 Operator sharing the equipped Operator's primary Alliance
Equipped Operator cannot be healed by other sources, and recovers 75 HP per second
Destroyed when equipped; gain an extra 1 Funds at the start of each subsequent round
Destroyed when equipped; gain an extra 2 Funds next round
Immune to Stun, Frozen, and other abnormal statuses; if held together with "Unyielding Forcefield", combines into "Unyielding Aegis System"
Destroyed when equipped; choose 1 of 3 Commands to replace your current Command
Equipped Operator gains an additional Alliance determined by the other piece of Equipment they carry
Block +1, ATK +20%; each redeployment stacks these bonuses (stacks up to 2 times)
Whenever dealing damage, recovers HP equal to 5% of the damage dealt; if held together with "Siphoner's Heart", combines into "Siphoner's Scythe"

tabs.cnIdea:
阵容整体思路为前期停留二本至8-10回合（等到升本变为0-2费），搜简易通讯终端给大丑来得到金大丑（若大丑点金早则可以考虑早升本），后迅速升本至五本，搜维娜碰缪缪拿变形球，给大丑转职为维多利亚后并开出六维多利亚阵容成型

整体运营分为前期与后期两个阶段
——前期——
   —推荐盟约-推荐干员（重要级自上至下）—
       1.灵巧-云迹：必开盟约，前期多上云迹叠灵巧，可以极大的提升大丑战力
       2.奇迹-云迹：顺便叠奇迹，提升后期搜牌搜到推王的可能
       3.聚合-能开出来就行：由于大丑不吃奶，如何提升生存非常重要的，聚合能够给大丑持续回血，大大提升兜底能力
       4.坚守/助力-罗比菈塔：同上，若二碰三出了罗比可以用来叠坚守/助力
       5.远见-渡桥/空弦：若远见没ban可以开，不强求
   ——推荐装备——
       很多人不喜欢抓装备，而玩大丑维装备是非常重要的，道中一些强力装备能够给阵容带来质变，基本上看到必抓：
       1.简易通讯终端：用来得到三个大丑
       2.阿米娅/可露希尔玩偶：经济装备必抓
       3.回血饮料：提供自回血，提升大丑生存
   ——整体节奏——
       1回合抓两个干员（优先开盟约）
       2回合升本买装备
       悬赏可以无脑三块，只要大丑站位好基本都能收（投石车看情况，被冲飞过一次）
       后停留二本，开盟约帮助队友兜底，注意可留一些对子至后续升五后碰缪缪，三本可碰的干员也就空弦和罗比，碰出奥尔佳也可以考虑拿，乌萨斯面罩也是不错的装备
       后期速本至五本，搜维娜碰缪缪

——后期——
   ——推荐盟约-干员——
       1.维多利亚（二级）-维娜：也就是六维，为大丑提供极强的攻击能力，不强求高层数
       2.灵巧-帕拉斯：保证大丑在灵巧干员周围以吃到灵巧加成
       3.其他生存盟约看着开
   ——推荐装备——
       1.变形球+锤子：必备，需要为大丑专职维多利亚，锤子凯瑟琳会给，前期不一定要抓
       2.汲取者之镰：最强生存装备，大丑装备后无需担心生存问题
       3.不退者之盾：提供免控，十分重要
       4.骰子：换指令不会使大丑消失，换到点金等指令就是血赚
tabs.enIdea: Phase 1 (Rounds 1–9): Upgrade to Lv. 2 on Round 2 and stay at Lv. 2 until upgrading costs 0–2 Funds. Use Simple Communicators to promote "Rowdy Tin" to Elite, stack [Agile] and [Marvel] with Contrail, and grab economy dolls + Iridescent Revitalizing Drink.`nPhase 2 (Late Game): Fast-level to Lv. 5, roll for Vina Victoria, Jessica the Liberated, and Stainless, and find Damazti Isomorph + any Victorian Hammer to turn "Rowdy Tin" into a [Victoria] Operator. With 6 [Victoria] (+80% ATK per upgraded equipment across 4 slots!), Siphoner's Scythe, and Pallas's [Agile] buff, "Rowdy Tin" melts Bosses single-handedly.

cnTitle: 超级灵巧维，只追最上限！
enTitle: Hyper-Agile 6-Victoria Pallas & Tragodia Max Cap
author: 鹤叶武一

strategies.enEffect:
Passive: The first time Equipment is merged and upgraded each round, 3 pieces of Equipment appear in the Dispatch Center (may include Equipment 1 Tier higher); pick 1 for free
Tap to use (Cost 0): Replace 1 piece of Equipment in the Dispatch Center with a new one (up to 2 times per round)

items.enEffect: Equipped Operator gains the special effects of all Victorian Hammers currently on the field, and gains an additional +20% ATK for each type of special-effect Victorian Hammer present
Equipped Operator gains an additional Alliance determined by the other piece of Equipment they carry

tabs.cnIdea: 酒神疯狂发装备，dj疯狂叠层，三助力二坚守，提供坦度，有转职给帕拉斯，1秒千鞭轻松过终极！运气好9人口还可以再上一个铃兰，或者中期上铃兰在酒神后面发装备。
tabs.enIdea: Tragodia hands out free Equipment every round while Stainless upgrades them and Jessica the Liberated stacks [Victoria] and [Durable] for every equipped Operator on the field. Run 3 [Aid] + 2 [Durable] for a frontline wall, and give Pallas a [Victoria] Isomorph + Ultimate Victorian Hammer so she unleashes ultra-high-ASPD whips under 6 [Victoria].

tabs.cnIdea: 这套阵容以精准和奥术为核心，莱塔尼亚并不需要强行开六人口，六人口莱塔尼亚的收益也远没有精准和奥术的三阶强，开局前期也不用强行找莱塔尼亚的牌，而是更优先拿摆渡人折娅这种强力单卡，或者优先留对子，莱塔尼亚的低阶牌刚需的有且仅有车尼尔，因为他给的小鼓可以极大幅度提高我们的战力和叠层速度，拿到的对子也别急着马上d牌合成，更推荐留到二级三级商店合成来抓核心卡，二阶商店时可以合成一两个尝试找空弦，即便找不到也不用慌，后续上三级商店合成找黑键和霍尔海雅，千万不要为了空弦而拖慢我们的节奏，可以在三级商店合成找黑键和霍尔海雅时顺带d空弦。这套玩法的核心干员为空弦黑键霍尔海雅小羊，都是中阶卡所以不很急升级，如果在合成时同时来优先级为道中黑键＞霍尔海雅＞小羊，boss时小羊优先级最高，因为是主力输出，在黑键来之前可以抓承曦格雷伊配合空弦叠加精准，给的狙击镜也是很适配空弦的装备，站位注意道中叠层时保证黑键站在空弦前方，精准叠够后可将空弦放置在小羊后方用以叠奥术，奥术不建议抓外援因为夕等干员的叠层机制和我们并不适配，更推荐抓精准的外援比如鸿雪等，此外，道中抓到的车尼尔给的小鼓也很适配霍尔海雅和鸿雪的叠层机制，如果在奶羊来之前觉得缺少生存，阿米娅，华法林，m3都是不错，的生存位还能兼顾叠层需求，分配一般为优先给霍尔海雅和鸿雪小鼓，其次给空弦和小羊，如果抓到缪尔赛斯可以看情况给转职，如果还在道中可以继续叠层就可以给霍尔海雅，这样她就可以一次叠莱塔尼亚精准奥术三个盟约，如果已经在boss前夕就可以给空弦，莱塔尼亚转空弦的伤害也很高，配合我们的策略陈的弱点伤害也能吃到三奥术的减法抗加成，场均单人30+输出轻轻松松，这套阵容的核心只有这七位，剩下的可以根据boss来对策，不过更推荐再上一个夜莺或者阿米娅魔王这样的保人干员，此外这套阵容对锏的需求无限低，甚至对六阶干员基本上都没什么需求，所以升级压力很小，八号位即便补褐果凑三聚合也比上锏要好
tabs.enIdea: Built around 3 [Precision] + 3 [Arcane] + Ch'en's Weakness damage Strategy rather than forcing 6 [Leithanien]. The only essential low-tier Leithanien unit is Czerny for his Leithanian Snare Drum (give Drums to Ho'olheyak and Archetto). Roll at Dispatch Center Lv. 3–4 to promote Archetto, Ebenholz, Ho'olheyak, and Eyjafjalla. Position Ebenholz in front of Archetto during mid-game rounds to stack [Precision], then move Eyjafjalla in front of Archetto to stack [Arcane] for Boss rounds—reaching 9,000+ ATK on Eyjafjalla.
